tour_welcome_content:
A real-time war room for network traffic analysis.

This tool helps you monitor connection paths, undersea cable flows, and potential risks. Let's see how to set it up!
tour_setup_content:
To ensure stable connection and precise analysis, please configure your DNS:

Primary DNS (This System): `35.221.247.16` 
Secondary DNS: `1.1.1.1` or `8.8.8.8` 

--- 
• Windows: Settings -> Network & Internet -> Ethernet/Wi-Fi -> Edit IP settings -> Manual.
• macOS: System Settings -> Network -> Wi-Fi/Ethernet -> Details -> DNS tab.
• iOS: Settings -> Wi-Fi -> tap (i) icon -> Configure DNS -> Manual.
• Android: Settings -> Network & Internet -> Private DNS or DNS settings in Wi-Fi details.

⚠️ Important: Always set a secondary DNS to prevent disconnection during system maintenance.

about_what_desc: SRRT is a real-time DNS traffic monitoring system designed for security analysis. It intercepts and analyzes all DNS queries passing through this node, automatically identifying applications, flagging foreign traffic, and visualizing global connection paths on a map.
about_how_desc: Once you point your device's DNS server to this system, all domain name resolution requests are routed through here. The system will:
about_how_1: Forward queries to upstream DNS resolvers (e.g., 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8)
about_how_2: Tag destination IPs with country, city, and ISP via GeoIP database
about_how_3: Identify applications using a three-tier recognition engine
about_how_4: Verify foreign traffic confidence through latency probing
about_how_5: Push results to the browser dashboard in real-time via WebSocket
about_privacy_desc: All data is stored exclusively in server memory (Ring Buffer) with no database or disk writes. All data is destroyed upon service restart, ensuring zero data retention risk.
about_tech_frontend: Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Zustand + MapLibre GL
about_footer: Built and maintained by Zeroflare Tech
